messages:
incident-bot: SEV-P0 alert: continuous-batcher latency > 10s across us-west-2a. Symptoms: CUDA OOMs, container restarts, heavy paging on nodes. Alert links: https://incidents.internal/1755004321 and runbook https://runbook.internal/continuous-batcher.md :rotating_light:

Priya (oncall): I'm picking this up. Grafana shows batcher queue length climbing steadily for ~6m, KV prefetch size skyrocketing. Multiple containers hit OOM-kill then restarted by kube. Marking customer-impacting.

Chen (eng-runtime): looking at logs now — seeing repeated:
```\n2026-06-02T21:12:03Z runtime ERROR: cudaCall failed: out of memory (cudaErrorMemoryAllocation)\nstack: serve.cpp:342 allocKVCache()\ncontinuous_batcher.cpp:128 grow_accumulator()\n```
Also a handful of `cudaErrorIllegalAddress` around the same time. Memory pages/sec on affected hosts = 4500.

Jamie (sre): Paging spikes usually mean prefetch/kvcache growth + large batches. Quick mitigation: disable prefetch, reduce max_batch_size and max_concurrent_batches for batcher service. I can apply k8s patch to the configmap if Priya approves.

Priya (oncall): approve. Apply changes small-first: set PREFETCH_ENABLED=false and BATCH_MAX_SIZE=1 for live groups, and scale replicas +1 to shift traffic.

Marta (eng-oncall): rolling config update now. Command I used:
```\nkubectl -n inference set env deploy/continuous-batcher PREFETCH_ENABLED=false BATCH_MAX_SIZE=1 --record\nkubectl -n inference rollout restart deploy/continuous-batcher\n```
I'll do a staggered rollout to avoid global impact.

SRE-Helper-Bot: runbook step executed: DISABLE_PREFETCH: success, ROLLOUT_START: 21:14:18Z, ANTIFRAGILE_SCALE +1: success.

Alex (support): Support: three paying customers (acct #A-844, B-1209, C-333) reported 502s. ETA for status update? I can post a short message to status.redwood.com: "Investigating elevated errors and latency in us-west-2; mitigation in progress."

Priya (oncall): yes please post now. Add "We have applied a temporary mitigation (disabled prefetch and reduced batch sizes). We will update when traffic normalizes or if rollback needed."

Chen (eng-runtime): after the rollout I'm still seeing two nodes with persistent page-fault storms and one host repeatedly OOMing during kernel allocation. Plan: cordon+drain i-0a3f2c, restart runtime container with debug flags and reduced prefetch thresholds, then bring back if stable. Commands:
```\nkubectl cordon node/i-0a3f2c\nkubectl drain node/i-0a3f2c --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data\nkubectl -n inference rollout restart ds/runtime-node\n```
I'll also increase swap-kill threshold at the kernel level temporarily to reduce flapping (ops approval?).

Jamie (sre): ops ok for temporary sysctl tweak at cluster level, but need to monitor. Also recommend applying eviction pressure controls so batcher doesn't hoard pages.

SRE-Helper-Bot: quick metrics: 21:13 -> tail latency p99 = 12.3s; 21:19 -> p99 = 0.78s after PREFETCH_DISABLED + BATCH_MAX_SIZE=1. Errors 502 -> down 87%. Still 2 hosts with high page-in rates.

Priya (oncall): confirming visible improvement. Keeping the incident open while we stabilize nodes. Handing to eng-runtime for deeper RCA and postmortem. @Chen you're action owner for follow-up (investigate why prefetch growth didn't respect caps and why kvcache growth triggers illegal CUDA addresses).

Chen (eng-runtime): taking ownership. Initial hypothesis: a race in the prefetch accounting code allowed speculative prefetch to bypass the quota during heavy burst workload, causing continuous batcher accumulator to grow unbounded and trigger kernel allocations that cross device limits -> OOM and illegal address on CUDA due to partial allocation failure. Will reproduce in staging with similar traffic profile and a memory-instrumented build.

Marta (eng-oncall): I'll keep the oncall channel monitoring for 30m then switch to chat-ops watch. If anything regresses, re-open paging mitigation and roll back to safe-mode: route traffic to smaller-model pool.

Alex (support): Posted status update at 21:21. Customers notified: "Mitigation applied, errors significantly reduced. Detailed postmortem to follow."

Priya (oncall): Final notes before handoff: - Mitigation: PREFETCH disabled, BATCH_MAX_SIZE=1, +1 replica to spread load, cordoned/drained one flaky node. - Impact: high tail latency and 502s for ~6m, ~3 customers affected, no data loss. - Next: eng-runtime to triage root cause and plan patch + rollout.

Chen (eng-runtime): I'll schedule a dedicated debug window and post a draft RCA in #eng-runtime within 24 hours. If anyone has logs/snippets from affected runs, DM me.

SRE-Helper-Bot: incident updated: owner=Chen (eng-runtime), sev=P1 -> under investigation. incident channel will remain open until nodes stable. :white_check_mark:
